research_goal: receding-consistent optimizer-supported all-109 Direct-TFV MPC under sparse causal sensing

core_pipeline.step1: causal sparse sensing -> current full-network hydraulic reconstruction
core_pipeline.step2: causal current state + causal rainfall + complete H360 reference/candidate actions -> authoritative exact delta TFV
core_pipeline.sequence_support: label-independent D3 TrainFit HOLD-reference q95 joint temporal trust region
core_pipeline.raw_optimizer: unchanged V6 all-109 screening plus q95 support-contracted H120 L-BFGS-B search
core_pipeline.search_plan: H120 free plan plus terminal hold through H360 remains search guidance only
core_pipeline.execution_estimand: score the optimized first H10 block followed by HOLD_ACTIVE_TARGET for H350; this is the only action committed before the next observation
core_pipeline.receding_prefix_calibration: on the same 10 fresh Development rainfall groups, authoritative SWMM labels one executable-prefix query per group; 90% one-sided rainfall-group conformal residual bound
core_pipeline.step3: execute the V6 optimized first move iff its receding-prefix calibrated TFV upper bound is < 0; V2 full-plan margin is diagnostic and no longer controls execution
core_pipeline.swmm: authoritative offline calibration/evaluation truth only; never called inside online candidate search

action_contract.engineering_bounds: physical min/max plus <=0.5 setting movement per 10-minute update
action_contract.per_facility_support: TrainFit q95 first-move and sequence magnitude
action_contract.joint_temporal_support: D3-HOLD q95 first-block L1 mass, H120 L1 mass and H120 temporal total variation, enforced inside the differentiable decoder

scientific_bottleneck.evidence: V9 reduced the policy margin from 156384 to 102726 m3, but fresh P15/P35/P75 closed loops beat No-control on only 2/3 events and Auto-RBC on 0/3. Exact H360 replay remained directionally strong for accepted plans (6/6 beneficial), while 9/10 rejected plans were also truly beneficial. P35 was 3.877% worse than No-control despite locally beneficial H360 plans, showing that full-plan value is not the same estimand as the H10 action actually committed before replanning.
scientific_bottleneck.mechanism_under_test: whether calibrating and admitting the executable H10 prefix rather than the uncommitted H120/H360 plan restores event-level consistency without sacrificing action availability
scientific_bottleneck.next_test: build a 10-rainfall-group EXECUTE_H10_THEN_HOLD_H350 calibration panel from frozen V6 first moves, derive its 90% one-sided margin, then test V8 on newly preregistered Development events not used in V9 design

step3_current.active_support: q95 canonical; q90/q99 not permitted for current V10 evidence

promotion_rule: first obtain a valid rainfall-disjoint 90% receding-prefix calibration; then on newly preregistered Development events show zero support/engineering violations, event-level No-control non-inferiority, preserved exact prefix/H360 sign reliability and improved competitiveness versus Internal/Auto-RBC without weakening any baseline; only then consider untouched Validation
